## 📌 How This Repo Is Organized

Each folder contains a `README.md` covering that topic in depth — explanations plus runnable code examples — meant as both a personal reference and a study log while learning Python.

Every subfolder's `README.md` should start like this so the auto-generator can read it correctly:
